caption: The drawing features a single, centrally-placed object with a rounded top and a flat base, resembling an arch or dome shape. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and the object casts no shadow. The paper shows minor discoloration and a few small reddish-brown spots in the lower left area, and there are faint diagonal patterns in the top left and right corners, possibly from the texture or markings on the paper itself.
